historyWindow.title: Dictation History
historyWindow.openRoute: Open Koncus Nai Settings, then select Manage Dictation History. The tray command Open Dictation History is an alternative.

owners.responsibility: rendering, selection, editor state, and UI event forwarding
latest-query cancellation, bounded loading, filtering, and stable results
serialized save/delete commands, cancellation, typed outcomes, and shutdown
plaintext versioned JSONL persistence, corrupt-line preservation, and atomic rewrites
single modeless History window and refresh shutdown
Workbench-specific history query, selection, mutation, and cache reconciliation

operatorCases.setup: Open Koncus Nai Settings, select Manage Dictation History, and use the empty or no-selection state. Do not create a real dictation solely for this case.
operatorCases.action: Press Tab through Search dictation history and the entries list. Confirm the editor, Save, and Delete are unavailable without a selection.
operatorCases.expected: Search and the list are reachable; the empty state is understandable; the editor, Save, and Delete do not accept focus while disabled.
operatorCases.report: Report the focus sequence, empty-state message, unexpected enabled actions, and PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED without quoting stored text.

operatorCases.setup: Select one explicitly test-owned non-sensitive entry in Dictation History.
operatorCases.action: Inspect the selected detail, date/time, editor, Save, and Delete. Do not change the entry.
operatorCases.expected: The localized date/time and editor appear without repeating a type label or selected title; Save is disabled until the text changes; Delete is enabled.
operatorCases.report: Report the displayed date/time format, duplicated labels, action states, and one classification without recording entry text.

operatorCases.setup: Select an explicitly test-owned entry and remember only its test identifier, not its text.
operatorCases.action: Move the caret into the editor, make a harmless edit, confirm Save becomes enabled, save, close Dictation History, reopen it, and reselect the same test entry.
operatorCases.expected: Caret movement is stable, Save is enabled only while dirty, one save occurs, the saved test edit remains after reopen, and Save returns to disabled.
operatorCases.report: Report caret behavior, Save-state transitions, persistence after reopen, and one classification without quoting the entry.

operatorCases.setup: Select an explicitly test-owned entry that may be deleted later.
operatorCases.action: Activate Delete, choose Cancel in the confirmation dialog, and inspect the selection and editor afterward.
operatorCases.expected: The modal confirmation contains a destructive action and Cancel; cancelling retains the entry, selection, editor, and focus context.
operatorCases.report: Report dialog focus, cancellation status, retained selection, focus destination, and one classification.

operatorCases.setup: Select an explicitly test-owned disposable entry. Never use personal History for this case.
operatorCases.action: Activate Delete, confirm deletion once, search for the test identifier, close Dictation History, reopen it, and search again.
operatorCases.expected: Exactly the selected test-owned session is removed, the editor/actions clear, no duplicate dialog appears, and the entry remains absent after reopen.
operatorCases.report: Report affected entry count, editor/action state, persistence after reopen, and one classification without recording content.

operatorCases.setup: Have at least two non-sensitive test-owned entries with distinct safe identifiers.
operatorCases.action: Search for one identifier, then a no-match value, then clear Search. Repeat once rapidly and select an entry before clearing.
operatorCases.expected: Only the latest query controls the list; no-match clears stale detail/actions; clearing restores matching records; no stale result replaces the newer query.
operatorCases.report: Report counts and selection/action transitions only, plus PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED.

operatorCases.setup: Select a test-owned entry, make an unsaved harmless edit, and leave the editor focused.
operatorCases.action: Cause a safe History refresh by adding another test-owned entry through the approved fixture procedure. Then change Search so the selected entry is filtered out.
operatorCases.expected: Refresh preserves the unsaved editor and caret while the same selected entry exists; filtering it out clears stale detail, Save, and Delete.
operatorCases.report: Report draft/caret preservation and filtered-out action states without quoting text, or BLOCKED if no approved fixture procedure exists.

operatorCases.setup: Use the baseline environment, then test Dark and Light separately. Test High Contrast, 200% text size, and available display scaling only when settings can be safely restored.
operatorCases.action: At each available variant, open Dictation History, test empty and selected states, Tab and Shift+Tab, minimum-size layout, focus visibility, and status announcements.
operatorCases.expected: The continuous surface remains legible, focus is visible, actions remain reachable, and no text/control clips or overlaps. High Contrast is separate from Dark/Light.
operatorCases.report: Report each environment variant separately as PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED and confirm every changed setting was restored.

operatorCases.setup: Use only an approved test profile capable of producing a reversible History load/save failure. If none exists, classify this case BLOCKED.
operatorCases.action: Trigger the test-owned failure once, verify the safe status, restore the fixture, retry, and close the window during a separate bounded test operation.
operatorCases.expected: The status is concise and contains no raw exception or path; cancellation is distinct from failure; retry recovers once; closure leaves no late update or duplicate operation.
operatorCases.report: Report only the safe status category, retry/cancellation outcome, and classification. Do not report exception text or paths.
